candidates.search_snippet: Metro adds 12 extra trains on national exam day.
candidates.source_content: The city metro operator will run 12 additional trains on the morning of the national college entrance exam so that candidates reach the test sites on time. Vehicles will be kept away from the area 200 metres in front of the test sites. Normal service resumes after the morning peak.
